_comment: Rows this project appends to STOCK sub-lists, one entry per host menu. tools/gen_menu_hosts.py turns this into the host-owned
entries of kraken_ui.patch.json (labels, label arrays, descriptor pointers/counts, relocated dispatch jump tables and their
cmphsi bounds) and into krk_menu_rows.h (KRK_<HOST>_FIRST/_MAX/_GEN_MODE/_ITEM_<ROW>/_ROWS for krk_core.c, krk_ext.c, krk_stubs.S).
The build runs the script with --check and fails while either output is stale.
Adding a row to an existing host: append it to that host's rows (key, label, screen = a C initializer for its struct krk_screen
pointer), run tools/gen_menu_hosts.py, rebuild. Rows of an extension-blob host (APRS, Radio Settings, Channel Set) live in
krk_ext.c's table, so the screen must be linked in blob 2 or be referenced by its blob origin (KRK_EXT4_LO, KRK_EXT5_LO).
An option row (.opt) needs a commit path: APRS, Radio Settings and Channel Set have one; Call Log and GNSS take screens only.
Adding a host: its splice SITES (the generator call, the item-action compare chain or jump table, the commit) are reverse-engineering
work and stay hand-written in the manifest and krk_stubs.S; this file covers everything that follows from the row list.
Fields: descriptor = the stock {u32 strings, u8 count, u8 subtype} x 2 languages; stock = its arrays (expect_* checked at build);
arrays_at / labels_at / jump_tables[].at = where the relocated copies go in the kraken_ui_data claim (overlaps are rejected);
gen_mode = the menu_option_list_dispatch mode whose list krk_hook_gen appends to (omit when the descriptor count alone lists the rows);
gen_sites = the call sites of that generator (each a stock `bsr menu_option_list_dispatch`, name/addr/why) that become `bsr krk_hook_gen`;
why = 'why' text templates for the generated entries ({stock} {n} {total} {first} {last} {items} {labels}; label: also {item} {label}).
Beyond plain hosts: the 'cat' host is the 11th top-level category (naming overrides, no_header, three jump_tables) and 'nests' holds the
Other Func parents (a per-slot 4-splice template) and the VOX child-list descriptor. See docs/menu-hosts.md section 3.

why.catjmp: render-path table: ten stock case blocks + ours
why.okjmp: OK-path table: ten stock 6-byte stubs + ours
why.itemjmp: item-action table: ten stock case blocks + ours

why.arr_zh: stock APRS zh strings + analog rows (descriptor 0x030ba924 lang 0): {items} ({labels}). Upload ID and Upload Beacon reuse the stock strings of items 1 and 6; the rest are ours
why.arr_en: stock APRS en strings + analog rows (descriptor lang 1), same layout as zh
why.itemjmp: APRS per-item jump table: {stock} stock case blocks + {n} stub entries ({items}: {labels})
why.aprs_item_bound: cmphsi r2,{stock} -> cmphsi r2,{total} (raw imm = value-1): {items} are ours
why.aprs_item_table_ptr: pool word loaded by the lrw at 0x0303d55a
why.label: label of APRS item {item} ({label}), an analog row (docs/aprs-submenu.md)

hosts._note: each APRS label is pinned where it was first placed (label_at); a new APRS row without label_at is packed from labels_at

gen_sites.name: calllog_gen_render
gen_sites.why: Call Log render case block 0x0303dbf6 (fresh entry, depth 1): menu_option_list_dispatch(5, 0x3e5f8, 0x3e5fa) -> krk_hook_gen (stock generator, then our rows from menu_hosts.json). Void; after it the block reloads r3 and uses nothing else

gen_sites.name: calllog_gen_entry2
gen_sites.why: second Call Log entry path (history push at 0x03036b40, depth 14): same generator call; after it only fresh r2/r3 and calls

gen_sites.name: calllog_gen_entry3
gen_sites.why: third Call Log entry path (rebuilds the list and puts the cursor on item r4): generator(5, r5, r6); after it only r4/r5 (callee-saved) and fresh registers

why.arr_zh: stock Call Log zh strings (descriptor 0x030b8060 lang 0: Missed, Answered, Sent, Delete) + {items} {labels} (docs/calllog-submenu.md)
why.desc_zh_ptr: Call Log sub-list descriptor (category 4), docs/calllog-submenu.md; the arrays are read only through it
why.arr_en: stock Call Log en strings (descriptor lang 1) + {items} {labels}
why.label: label of Call Log {item} ({label}), docs/calllog-submenu.md

why.arr_zh: stock GNSS zh strings (descriptor 0x030b7e28 lang 0: GNSS On/Off, GNSS Info, Time Zone, Disp Format, GNSS Mode) + {items} {labels}
why.desc_zh_ptr: GNSS sub-list descriptor (category 8), docs/gnss-submenu.md; the arrays are read only through it (readers 0x030386fc, 0x0303dd10, 0x0303f270)
why.label: label of GNSS {item} ({label}), docs/gnss-submenu.md; the title handler 0x030386e8 draws it from the relocated array

gen_sites.name: rs_gen_hook
gen_sites.why: Radio Settings entry block 0x030423a8: menu_option_list_dispatch(20, 0x3e5f8, 0x3e5fa) -> krk_hook_gen (stock generator, then our rows from menu_hosts.json). The only call site of mode 20 in the image; void, and after it the block reloads r3 from a literal

why.arr_zh: stock Radio Settings zh strings (descriptor 0x030b8488 lang 0: Voice/Key/Display/Other Func) + {items} ({labels})
why.desc_zh_ptr: Radio Settings sub-list descriptor (Settings category 5, item 0), docs/settings-submenu.md; the arrays are read only through it and by the level-4 header handler, which indexes the same array
why.arr_en: stock Radio Settings en strings (descriptor lang 1) + {items} ({labels})
why.label: label of Radio Settings {item} ({label}), docs/settings-submenu.md; the level-4 header handler 0x03038720 draws it straight from the relocated array, so no title hook is needed

gen_sites.name: cs_gen_hook
gen_sites.why: Channel Set row generator: menu_option_list_dispatch(6, 0x3e5f8, 0x3e5fa) @0x030493f8 (body menu_option_gen_idx6 @0x03049930, a 21-arm CPS/channel-mode visibility chain) -> krk_hook_gen, which calls the stock generator FIRST so all its gating keeps working and only then appends our rows (menu_hosts.json). This is the MENU-TREE call site; the second mode-6 call at 0x0303e294 belongs to a different wizard that installs cells from descriptor 0x030b8150 (CTC/DCS) and never reads 0x030b89a0, so it is deliberately NOT hooked. Void; after it the block reloads r3

rows.label: Burst Voice
rows.stubs_why: 2026-11-06: a nest parent (docs/chanset-submenu.md 8). Its level-4 init entry installs the child list (Burst Voice, Mode, Key-up Lead, Relay Capture; krk_bvcfg.c); its commit entry is stock's row-15 arm 0x0304e254 = set_mode(0x23, 1), which opens level 5 for any child. The screen stays the row's `screen`: krk_hook_gen lists the row only while blob ui4 is flashed

why.arr_zh: stock Channel Set zh strings (descriptor 0x030b89a0 lang 0, {stock} rows Rx Frequency..APRS Receive) + {items} ({labels}). The two stock arrays abut each other and the descriptor (zh+88 = en, en+88 = the descriptor), so neither can grow in place: both are relocated. 2026-11-03: the four relocated tables abutted one another at their old addresses, so they were MOVED here
why.desc_zh_ptr: Channel Set sub-list descriptor (Settings category 5, level-2 item 1), docs/chanset-submenu.md. The literal 0x030b89a0 occurs at five sites (0x30387c4, 0x303ba8c, 0x303c1d8, 0x303c3fc, 0x3042534) and every one of them loads the DESCRIPTOR, so editing it in place covers all readers - including the level-4 header handler, which gives the new rows their titles for free
why.desc_zh_count: Channel Set row count: stock {stock}, now {total} for the {n} rows we append ({labels}). A plain count here, not the value-1 encoding the cmphsi bounds use
why.arr_en: stock Channel Set en strings (descriptor lang 1), same layout as zh: {stock} stock + {n} of ours. 2026-11-03: the four relocated tables abutted one another at their old addresses, so they were MOVED here
why.desc_en_count: Channel Set row count: stock {stock}, now {total} for the {n} rows we append ({labels}). A plain count here, not the value-1 encoding the cmphsi bounds use
why.itemjmp: Channel Set ENTER jump table (OK on the row, event 0x1b): {stock} stock case blocks of table_entry_select_and_index_list_build_toplevel_dispatch @0x03047324 + {n} stub entries ({items}). The stock table 0x030b0a18 is packed directly before 0x030b0a70 so it must be relocated; its only reference is the literal-pool word at 0x03047370. 2026-11-03: the four relocated tables abutted one another at their old addresses, so they were MOVED here
why.cs_item_bound: ENTER dispatch bound of table_entry_select_and_index_list_build_toplevel_dispatch @0x03047324: cmphsi r2,{stock} -> cmphsi r2,{total} (raw immediate = value - 1; a 16-bit cmphsi tops out at 32, which tools/gen_menu_hosts.py enforces), so level-3 {items} reach our table entries instead of the out-of-range exit 0x03047cf4. MEASURED in QEMU (docs/nested-submenu.md): this dispatcher is the one the OK on a level-3 row reaches, and it is reached at that depth only
why.cs_item_table_ptr: literal-pool word loaded by the lrw at 0x03047338 (the table's sole reference image-wide)
why.okjmp: Channel Set COMMIT jump table (OK INSIDE a row's option level, event 0x22): {stock} stock case blocks of 0x0304dc8c + {n} stub entries ({items}). MEASURED 2026-11-03: the committing OK runs 0x0303a57c -> bsr 0x0304e560 -> jump table 0x030b11c4[1] = 0x0304e5aa -> bsr 0x0304dc8c, which re-reads the level-3 row and dispatches it through THIS table - unlike Radio Settings (0x030b11c4[0] = a pure no-op), so the row never has to be latched. The stock table 0x030b116c is immediately followed by 0x030b11c4 so it must be relocated; its only reference is the literal-pool word at 0x0304dcc0. 2026-11-03: the four relocated tables abutted one another at their old addresses, so they were MOVED here
why.cs_ok_bound: COMMIT dispatch bound of 0x0304dc8c: cmphsi r3,{stock} -> cmphsi r3,{total} (raw immediate = value - 1). Its out-of-range target 0x0304e416 is NOT an epilogue (it is the stock numeric / Channel-Name path), so a row of ours must never fall out through the bound. MEASURED in QEMU (docs/nested-submenu.md): this is where the OK pressed at any level BELOW a level-3 row arrives, which is also why a nested child list cannot open its own option level from here - docs/nested-submenu.md
why.cs_ok_table_ptr: literal-pool word loaded by the lrw at 0x0304dca0 (the table's sole reference image-wide)
why.label: label of Channel Set {item} {label} (docs/chanset-submenu.md). The level-4 header handler 0x03038720 special-cases category 5 and, for level-2 item 1, reads lrw a3,[0x30387c4] = 0x030b89a0 then desc[lang].ptr[row], so relocating the label arrays titles the row in both languages with no title hook

why.lbl: Other Func {lang} label array slot {slot} (stock: {stock_name}, never listed) -> {label}

items.label: CW ID
items.label_why: label of Other Func item 11 (2026-11-05, docs/cw-id.md, docs/otherfunc-submenu.md). Stock never lists item 10 (Lone Worker) or 11 (Man Down): the generator skips them and their slots in both per-item tables are the no-op exits, so the Man Down slot is reused as the CW ID parent row with no table relocation. The level-5 header 0x03038994 reads 0x030b8708[lang].ptr[item], so the label also titles the child list
items.enter_why: Other Func level-5 init table 0x030b0990, slot 11 (stock: the no-op exit) -> installs the CW ID child list (CW ID SW, Interval, Callsign), as 0x030449ec does for VOX (slot 3). Runs on every render of the level, including the re-render after a child commits
items.ok_why: Other Func level-5 OK table 0x030b130c, slot 11 (stock: the popup-and-pop tail) -> stock's own VOX arm 0x0304fec8 = set_mode(0x2a,1); br 0x030500ac. It tests neither the row nor the child, so level 6 opens for any child, and the level-6 init hook decides what it is

zh.name: krk_vox_kids_zh
zh.why: stock VOX child list, zh (descriptor 0x030b82b8 lang 0: VOX SW, Gain Level) + child 2 = stock's own VOX Delay string (Other Func zh array slot 4). The stock arrays are packed against their neighbours and the descriptor. The level-5 installer 0x030449ec and the level-6 header 0x03038b9e both follow the descriptor's count and pointer, so the third row and its title are data only
zh.ptr_why: VOX child-list descriptor (Other Func item 3), docs/otherfunc-submenu.md: two literal users, the level-5 installer (0x03044af0) and the level-6 header (0x03038cf0), both through this descriptor
zh.count_why: VOX children: VOX SW, Gain Level, and now VOX Delay (it was Other Func row 4)

en.name: krk_vox_kids_en
en.why: stock VOX child list, en (VOX SW, Gain Level) + child 2 = stock's VOX Delay string (Other Func en array slot 4)
